title: Prowl
description: Instructions on how to add Prowl notifications to Home Assistant.
body:
The **Prowl** integration uses [Prowl](https://www.prowlapp.com/) to deliver push notifications from Home Assistant to your iOS device.

## Prerequisites

Go to the [Prowl website](https://www.prowlapp.com/) and create a new API key.

API key:
  description: "The Prowl API key you created on the Prowl website."

## Sending notifications

The **Prowl** integration adds a notify entity for each configured API key. To send a notification, use the [**Send a notification message**](/actions/notify.send_message/) (`notify.send_message`) action and select the Prowl notify entity as the target. To set a priority or attach a URL, use the [**Prowl: Send message**](/actions/prowl.send_message/) (`prowl.send_message`) action instead.

action: |
  action: notify.send_message
  target:
    entity_id: notify.prowl
  data:
    title: "Reminder"
    message: "Have you considered frogs?"

## Prowl automation examples

You can use this integration to send a push notification to your iOS device when something happens in your home.

### Automation: send a notification when the front door opens

This automation sends a high-priority notification when the front door opens.

- **Trigger**: Door opened
  - **Target**: Front door (`binary_sensor.front_door`)
- **Action**: Send message
  - **Target**: Prowl (`notify.prowl`)
  - **Priority**: High

**YAML example for a notification when the front door opens**

automation: |
  alias: "Prowl: front door opened"
  triggers:
    - trigger: door.opened
      target:
        entity_id: binary_sensor.front_door
  actions:
    - action: prowl.send_message
      target:
        entity_id: notify.prowl
      data:
        title: "Front door"
        message: "The front door was opened."
        priority: high

## Removing the integration

This integration follows standard integration removal. No extra steps are required.
